chapter_title: The Three Earths that Exist, they bear Fruit.
chapter_note: The oldest teaching layer is concentrated in ¶¶2–3 (and the teaching portion of ¶1): a threefold correspondential schema of “earth/field” (physical earth → Living Soul in the cosmic zone → later grafted ‘holy church’). ¶4 is a classic editorial seam: it mimics the same “earth/field + farmer” pattern but crosses from cosmos→institution (holy church, elect, catechumens), so the whole paragraph is late pastoral extension despite its cosmological diction (Light Mind). ¶5 is explicit exhortation/application to the audience (preach, toil), hence pastoral.

paragraphs.core_text: Three earths exist in the universe, and are being toiled over. At first they [...] the farmer in them. Afterwards they bear [good] fruit to they who toil over them.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once again he speaks to his disciples:” (a compilation-layer formula).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens with a formulaic frame marker, then immediately shifts into impersonal, structural exposition (“Three earths exist…”) characteristic of the cosmological-correspondential substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: One of them is this great earth that people are living upon. They are ploughing in it [...], it with iron hoes, they cultivate, [making] the furrows, turning it over [...] Afterwards they harvest fruit from [it ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, descriptive “how it works” presentation establishing the first term in a numbered triad; no citation, exhortation, or institutional targeting.

paragraphs.core_text: The second field is the living soul, the holy one. It is mixed in the entire zone, above and below. The farmers who toil over it are these two great light-givers, which journey through the heavens. They are toiling and cultivating it, so that they will draw it towards their aspect. And it leaps up and comes to the heights. It goes upwards, out from every place wherein it is, and it adds to them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Clear cosmos→cosmos mapping: ‘field’ = Living Soul in the zone; ‘farmers’ = the two light-givers (sun and moon) in heavenly motion drawing it upward. This is systematic correspondential teaching without institutional application.

Editorial seam/extension: continues the ‘third earth/field + farmer’ template but the mapping crosses into institutional present (holy church, elect, catechumens). Per the seam rule, the entire paragraph belongs to the late pastoral graft, even though it uses cosmological names (Light Mind).

Direct second-person exhortation and mission-instruction (“You yourselves… Preach… Open the eyes… Rather, toil!”) shifts from describing cosmic processes to addressing audience behavior—late pastoral/application layer.
